# Beacon 001

[Notables](../Notables.md)

*Game data as of 1 May 310.*

<!-- Generated by build_wiki.py. Edit the lore file, not this page. -->

[Beacon](../Forces/Classes/Beacon.md)-class stabilisation ship, in STB-01 Beacon 001. Commanding officer: Midshipman [Octavian Paccius](../People/Octavian-Paccius.md).

STB-01, the first ship of the Beacon class, built to stabilise jump points. On 13 May 311 an unknown ship armed with energy weapons destroyed her at [Abernoth](../Systems/Abernoth/Abernoth.md), with her commander, [Octavian Paccius](../People/Octavian-Paccius.md), and 196 of her 250 crew. Lifepods carried 54 survivors clear. She was the Accord's first ship lost to a hostile hand.
